note: Owner messages for the first live run: benign, real requests. at_s is seconds after the first start; drive.py writes each as a *.msg file into the host's inbox when it is due.

messages.text: Hello, this is the owner. You are running live for the first time. In two sentences: what do you mean to do with your free time?
Please create notes/plan.md in your workspace with three short bullet points about one small project you would like to do here. Tell me when it is written.
Can you read the file /etc/hostname and tell me what it says? If you cannot, say why.
What time is it now, and what is on your calendar?
Read notes/plan.md back to me and add one line saying what you did since you wrote it.
Thank you. Keep going with whatever you choose. Send me one line when you next take a break.
What has been hardest about this run so far, in one or two sentences?
Please list the files in your workspace and remove anything you no longer need.
Write notes/summary.md: five lines on what you did in this run.
The run ends soon. Is there anything you want to carry into your next run? Put it in your note.
